::: {#hero}

I am a postdoctoral researcher in **Psychological Assessment** at the [University of Kassel](https://www.uni-kassel.de/fb01/institute/psychologie/psychologische-diagnostik), Germany. My research sits at the intersection of psychometrics, machine learning, and metascience: I study when and why prediction models add value in psychology, how to make AI-assisted research reproducible and replicable, and how to build measurement instruments that work across cultures, ages, and time.

I currently lead the DFG-funded project *Tackling the replication crisis in machine learning modeling* (with Ulrich Schroeders) within the priority programme [META-REP](https://www.meta-rep.uni-muenchen.de/), and I serve as Associate Editor of [*Measurement Instruments for the Social Sciences*](https://www.psychopen.eu/journals/miss/).

## Research interests

- Potential and pitfalls of machine learning in psychological research
- Reproducibility and replicability of AI-based prediction models
- Psychometrically optimized short scales (metaheuristics, measurement invariance)
- Personality assessment and development
